name: Disable
body:
School necromancy; Level cleric/oracle 9

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fort negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

Disable removes all but 1d4 hit points from the target creature and permanently reduces all of its ability scores to 3. This damage cannot be healed by normal means; only a combination of heal and greater restoration, or more powerful magic, can restore the target’s hit points and abilities.

If the target is undead, the spell heals all but 1d4 hit points of damage to the target, similar to a harm spell, and restores any ability damage the target has suffered.
